hope_gu: Use case: stylized-concept. Project asset: transparent bestiary portrait for a Chinese cultivation game, Hope Gu (希望蛊). Closely follow its textual appearance: one tiny frail point of weak white light, dim and plain, with no discernible insect anatomy. Render a single small pearl-white luminous mote with a soft irregular almost transparent halo and a few delicate gauze-like wisps very close to the core. Modest subdued brightness, gentle warm ivory core and cool white edges, subtle ink-and-gouache painterly softness. The core and halo together occupy about the central 45 percent of the square canvas, with generous clear margin. This is a single living mote of hope, not a star-shaped creature, not a butterfly, not a glowing beetle, not an orb with a face. No wings, legs, eyes, runes, decorative magic rings, rainbow colors, constellation, text, label, UI, pedestal, ground, shadow, scenery or background. True transparent alpha background, soft translucent edges, readable on a dark game interface.
